review_note: EID revenue fell about 40% and adjusted operating profit 70%, MCL had a problem project and weaker margin, and SEA entered the next year with low order cover. SEA's completed restructuring was already announced and is excluded. Group adjusted margin fell 50bps, with MCL down 140bps and EID down about 1,220bps. Working-capital absorption weakened cash conversion and the Chess acquisition moved the Group to £6.4m net debt. Record £190.9m order book and growing Group profit provided strong offsets.

Supply-chain prices, programme delays and operating inefficiencies at EID and Chess were repeated, with EID marginally loss-making. Group adjusted margin fell 80bps and statutory gross margin fell from 41% to 36%, largely because of mix, while both operating divisions remained profitable overall. Record revenue and adjusted operating profit, a record £329.1m order book extending to 2032, robust cash conversion and higher net funds of £15.6m supplied multiple strong quantified offsets.
